creator: cookduck
title: One-Pan Chorizo Orzo
description: The orzo cooks in the stock and the chorizo oil. One pan, twenty minutes, no draining.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, until the fat runs red.
Add the onion and pepper and cook for 6 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the orzo and turn it in the oil for 1 minute.
Pour in the hot stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 9 minutes, stirring now and then, until the orzo is tender and the liquid has gone.
Rest off the heat for 2 minutes, then stir through the parsley.

creator: cookduck
title: Crisp Garlic Butter Gnocchi
description: Shop-bought gnocchi, fried not boiled, until the outsides blister. Faster than pasta and better.
steps: Heat the butter in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat until it foams.
Add the gnocchi straight from the packet, in one layer, and leave them alone for 4 minutes so they colour.
Turn and cook for 3 minutes more, until crisp on both sides.
Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 45 seconds — it burns fast.
Fold in the spinach until it wilts, about 1 minute.
Off the heat, toss with the Parmesan.

creator: cookduck
title: Sheet-Pan Sausages with Fennel
description: Everything on one tray at one temperature. The fennel goes sweet and the sausage skins split.
steps: Heat the oven to 210C.
Toss the fennel, onion and lemon with the oil, fennel seeds and plenty of salt on a large tray.
Nestle the sausages among them, leaving space between everything.
Roast for 20 minutes.
Turn the sausages and roast for 15 minutes more, until browned all over and cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Squeeze the roasted lemon over before serving.

creator: cookduck
title: Miso Butter Noodles
description: Four minutes of work. The miso and butter make a sauce out of nothing but noodle water.
steps: Boil the noodles per the packet, then lift them out with tongs and keep a mugful of the water.
Mash the miso and butter together in the bowl you will eat from.
Add the hot noodles and 3 tbsp of the cooking water and toss until it turns into a sauce.
Add the soy, then the spring onion and sesame.

creator: cookduck
title: Harissa Chicken Traybake
description: Yoghurt keeps the chicken from drying and harissa does everything else. One tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Mix the harissa, yoghurt and lemon juice and rub it all over the chicken.
Toss the potatoes and onion with the oil on a large tray and season.
Sit the chicken on top, skin up, and roast for 40 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked through — the juices should run clear.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

creator: cookduck
title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Store-cupboard dinner. Mash half the beans so the filling holds together instead of falling out.
steps: Mash half the beans with the cumin, lime juice and salt; leave the rest whole and fold them in.
Spread over two tortillas, scatter with cheese and spring onion, and top with the others.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes, pressing down, until the underside is golden.
Flip carefully and cook 3 minutes more, until the cheese has melted through.
Rest for 1 minute before cutting, or the filling runs.

creator: cookduck
title: Tomato Butter Beans
description: Twenty minutes, one tin, and it tastes like it took an hour. Good with bread, better with an egg on top.
steps: Warm the oil over medium-low heat and cook the garlic and chilli for 2 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold — not brown.
Add the paprika and stir for 20 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, until they darken and thicken.
Add the beans and cook for 8 minutes more, crushing a few against the side.
Season well and finish with the parsley and a last pour of oil.

creator: cookduck
title: Crispy Chilli Eggs
description: Fried in far more oil than feels right, which is the point. The whites go lacy at the edges.
steps: Heat the oil in a small frying pan over high heat until it shimmers.
Crack in the eggs and stand back. Spoon the hot oil over the whites for 90 seconds, until the edges are brown and lacy and the yolks are still soft.
Lift out onto kitchen paper.
Spoon over the chilli crisp and vinegar and scatter with spring onion.

creator: cookduck
title: Pesto White Bean Salad
description: No cooking at all. Make it an hour ahead and it gets better sitting there.
steps: Stir the pesto, vinegar and oil together in a bowl with a good pinch of salt.
Add the beans and turn them until coated. Leave for 10 minutes if you have it.
Fold in the tomatoes and cucumber.
Add the rocket right before serving so it does not wilt.

creator: cookduck
title: Soy Butter Mushrooms on Toast
description: Do not move the mushrooms for the first three minutes. That is the whole trick.
steps: Get a wide frying pan properly hot over high heat, then add half the butter.
Add the mushrooms in one layer and leave them for 3 minutes without touching them, until they are browned underneath.
Toss and cook for 3 minutes more.
Add the garlic and the rest of the butter and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the soy and let it bubble away for 30 seconds.
Pile onto the toast with the parsley.

creator: cookduck
title: Cold Peanut Noodles
description: Sauce in the bottom of the bowl, hot noodles on top, toss. Eats hot or cold out of the fridge.
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, soy, vinegar, sesame oil and honey with 3 tbsp warm water until smooth and pourable.
Cook the noodles per the packet, then rinse them under cold water so they stop cooking.
Toss the drained noodles through the sauce.
Fold in the cucumber and spring onion just before eating.

creator: cookduck
title: Smashed Potatoes with Aioli
description: Boil, squash, roast hot. Crisp all over instead of just on top.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes, until a knife goes through with no resistance.
Drain and leave them to steam dry for 5 minutes — wet potatoes will not crisp.
Heat the oven to 220C.
Squash each potato flat with the base of a glass on an oiled tray.
Pour over the oil, season, and roast for 25 minutes, until the edges are deep brown and brittle.
Stir the garlic and lemon into the mayonnaise and serve alongside.

creator: cookduck
title: Proper Egg Fried Rice
description: Cold rice, hot pan, and nothing else in the pan while the egg sets. Uses up yesterday's rice.
steps: Break the cold rice up with your hands so there are no clumps left.
Get a wok smoking hot, add half the oil, and pour in the eggs.
Let them set for 20 seconds, then scramble roughly and tip them out while still slightly wet.
Add the rest of the oil and the white parts of the spring onion, then the rice.
Fry for 3 minutes, pressing the rice against the pan and turning, until it starts to pop.
Add the peas and the egg back, then the soy down the side of the pan.
Finish off the heat with the sesame oil and the green spring onion.

creator: cookduck
title: Tuna and White Bean Melt
description: The beans make it go further and stop it being all mayonnaise. Grilled, not toasted.
steps: Mash the beans roughly with a fork, leaving some whole.
Fold in the tuna, mayonnaise, celery, capers and lemon juice and season.
Pile onto two slices of bread, top with cheese and the other slices.
Cook in a dry pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese has melted.

creator: cookduck
title: Roast Tomato Soup
description: Roasting the tomatoes first is the difference between soup and hot tomato juice.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C.
Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic with the oil, sugar and salt on a tray, tomatoes cut side up.
Roast for 40 minutes, until the edges are blackened in places and the tomatoes have collapsed.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins and scrape everything into a blender with the stock.
Blend until smooth, then reheat and check the seasoning.
Tear the basil in at the end.

creator: cookduck
title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Dressing made in the bowl you toss it in. No anchovy fillets to chop, just the paste.
steps: Season the chicken and fry it in a little oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes a side, until golden and cooked through with no pink.
Rest it for 3 minutes, then slice.
Whisk the mayonnaise, anchovy paste, Parmesan, mustard and lemon in a large bowl.
Toss the lettuce through the dressing.
Pile the lettuce and chicken into the tortillas and roll tightly, tucking the ends in.

creator: cookduck
title: Shakshuka
description: Get the sauce properly thick before the eggs go in or they will poach into soup.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick enough that a spoon leaves a trail.
Make four wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, until the whites are fully set and the yolks are still soft.
Scatter with coriander and eat from the pan.

creator: cookduck
title: Sticky Soy Salmon
description: Fifteen minutes. The glaze reduces in the pan while the salmon finishes in it.
steps: Pat the salmon dry and season the skin well.
Fry skin side down in the oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, pressing flat, until the skin is crisp.
Turn and cook for 2 minutes more.
Mix the soy, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger and pour it in.
Let it bubble and thicken for 2 minutes, spooning it over the fish, until the salmon is just opaque through the middle.
Scatter with spring onion.

creator: cookduck
title: Halloumi and Herb Couscous
description: Couscous does not need cooking, only hot stock and ten minutes alone.
steps: Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over the boiling stock, cover and leave for 10 minutes.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan over medium-high heat for 2 minutes a side, until deeply golden.
Fork the couscous through to separate the grains.
Stir in the herbs, lemon juice, oil and plenty of pepper.
Top with the halloumi and the pomegranate.

creator: cookduck
title: Quick Pork Larb
description: Hot, sour, salty, and done in twelve minutes. The toasted rice powder is worth the extra two.
steps: Toast the raw rice in a dry pan over medium heat for 4 minutes, until nut brown, then grind it coarsely.
Fry the pork in a hot dry pan for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through with no pink.
Take it off the heat and let it stop sizzling.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, chilli and shallots and toss.
Fold in the herbs and the rice powder at the last moment, or it goes soft.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.
